subject: How to add (only) vertical space between faceted plots?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: How to add (only) vertical space between faceted plots?
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to increase the space between rows of a faceted plot. I
found this:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3681647/ggplot-how-to-increase-spacing-between-faceted-plots
Is there something like "opts(panel.margin.y = unit(2, "lines"))" to
increase only the space between the "rows" of the faceted plot, but
not the space between the columns?

Cheers,

Marius
